tasks.label: Pi: run full setup script
tasks.detail: Copies scripts/pi-setup.sh over and runs it interactively (real prompts — password, possibly sudo) — see the script's own comments for what it does and doesn't automate

tasks.label: Git: start branch
tasks.detail: Pulls main, then creates and switches to a new branch off it — see CLAUDE.md → Workflow
tasks.command: git checkout main && git pull && git checkout -b '${input:branchName}'

tasks.label: Git: open PR
tasks.detail: Pushes the current branch and opens a real PR via gh — never merges, that's a manual step for the person
tasks.command: git push -u origin HEAD && gh pr create --fill --web

tasks.label: Git: where am I
tasks.detail: Current branch, and how far it's diverged from main
tasks.command: echo "branch: $(git branch --show-current)"; git status --short; echo '---'; git log main..HEAD --oneline
